items.title: CXMT, Sandisk, ASML, SpaceX, D-Wave Quantum, Workday, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  A chip stock slide weighed on the major indexes following reports that a state-backed Chinese company has begun mass producing chip-making machines. Those same semiconductor companies, and many artificial-intelligence names, also were under pressure Monday after Chinese memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies ’(CXMT) massive trading debut.

items.title: 3 Reasons Lam Research Is Worth a Closer Look Before July 29 Q4 Earnings
items.summary: Lam Research reports Q4 earnings on July 29, and the setup heading into that print looks unlike anything its closest rivals can match right now. Three factors separate this semiconductor equipment name from the rest of the AI spending story.

items.title: Most Stocks Are Higher Despite the S&P 500's Reversal
items.summary: It's been a tough trading day for the S&P 500, but if you take a look under the surface, the market was actually holding up alright.  The S&P 500 was down 0.3% after trading more than 0.9% higher earlier in the session.  Chip stocks were the weakest link, with Sandisk, Coherent, and Lam Research as the index's worst performers.
